newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks spike near close to 97 intraday peak.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks spike near close to 97 intraday peak.

text.p: Taiwan share prices rose sharply in late trade on Friday, pushing to a 1997 intra-session high while riding on momentum from Wall Street's rally overnight, brokers said.
Just 10 minutes before close at 0350 GMT, the weighted index was up 2.00 percent or 180.16 points at 9,207.79, the market's highest intrasession level in 1997.
Turnover was heavy at T$145.64 billion, but still far short of the T$200 billion-plus levels attained regularly during the market's torrid June bull run.
Brokers said investors' confidence was sparked after the Dow Jones industrial average surged 1.29 percent on Wednesday to reach an all-time high of 7,895.81.
"The Dow Jones rise became contagious," said Joe Chiou, analyst for Taiwan Securities Investment.
Taiwan's market has gained well over 10 percent since the beginning of June.
